cases.note: One ATT Write Request or indication value carries at most ATT_MTU - 3 bytes, so the device's preferred 247-byte MTU yields a 244-byte ceiling.
Carrying the 192-byte protocol minimum therefore requires ATT_MTU >= 195, and 195 yields exactly it.
Below the minimum no negotiation is possible: Hello is answered resourceLimit/minimumControlFrame with retry-only-after-user-action, and nothing is admitted on that connection.
Below a 64-byte frame — the 16-byte header plus a text-free ErrorBody — the refusal itself is undeliverable, so the adapter disconnects rather than truncating an error.
The effective stream limit is min(negotiated stream maximum, CoC SDU), fixed at CoC establishment.
An SDU below the 64-byte floor refuses the channel with resourceLimit/minimumStreamFrame.
